why_it_passes: Same topic as the open backup server card but a different decision (a bigger, dearer server for speed), so it is not a repeat.

card.title: Faster server for the busy morning hours?
card.context: Between 8 and 9 am, when clinics open, booking pages take up to ten seconds to load. A server twice as fast costs $70 more a month. This is about speed, not about a backup.
card.question: Should the agent move us to a server twice as fast for $70 more a month?

choices.label: Yes, move
choices.pros: pages load in about two seconds at the morning rush

choices.label: No
choices.cons: mornings stay slow and staff keep complaining

card.why: Staff lose minutes every morning; $70 a month fixes it.

open_cards.title: Pay for a second server?
open_cards.context: All clinic data is on one server; a backup that takes over by itself costs $30 a month.
open_cards.question: Should the agent add a backup server for $30 a month?

open_cards.title: Move email to a new company?
open_cards.context: Our email company raises its price by half next month; another company costs the same as today.
open_cards.question: Should we move our email to the other company before the price rises?
